title: Tender Gap-Check Agent
outcome: RFQ gaps found in seconds, clarification letter drafted the same day.
summary: Solution designers lose days finding gaps in RFQ lane files and requirements before pricing can start. A Python checker with nine rules, a Power Automate flow and a Copilot Studio agent list every gap, draft the questions and propose a mode per lane.
cv: Inspired by: tender and RFQ solution design for large multinational accounts, from data discovery through to customer presentation.

cards.title: Every gap, with a rule and a severity
cards.caption: A 40-lane RFQ from a fictional shipper is checked against nine rules. Every gap is listed with its rule, severity and affected lanes, high severity first, to fix before pricing.
cards.alt: Tender Desk demo, Gaps tab: every gap listed with its rule id, severity and affected lanes

cards.title: Architecture
cards.caption: A new RFQ folder in SharePoint triggers a flow that runs the checker as an Azure Function, writes Dataverse rows, posts a Teams card and saves a summary file that grounds Copilot in Word and PowerPoint.
cards.alt: Architecture diagram: SharePoint, Power Automate, Azure Function, Dataverse, Teams, Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot in Word and PowerPoint

cards.title: Copilot Studio topic: Check new RFQ
cards.caption: The agent never computes gaps itself. It calls the checker flow and reports the counts it returns.
cards.code:
- kind: InvokeFlowAction
      id: runChecker
      flowId: 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000  # "Tender Desk - Run RFQ check" (see power-automate/run-rfq-check.md)
      input:
        binding:
          rfqFolder: =Topic.RfqFolder
      output:
        binding:
          tenderId: Topic.TenderId
          lanes: Topic.LaneCount
          gapsHigh: Topic.GapsHigh
          gapsMedium: Topic.GapsMedium
          gapsLow: Topic.GapsLow
          readinessPct: Topic.ReadinessPct
          topGaps: Topic.TopGaps

cards.title: Rule R06: transit times no truck can meet
cards.caption: Each rule is a few readable lines with a pytest case. The same rule runs in the demo page in JavaScript and is checked for identical output.

cards.title: GitHub Copilot ready
cards.body: Code drafted with AI pair programming and verified by 50 pytest tests and a Python to JavaScript parity check. The repo ships GitHub Copilot custom instructions (brand, British English, synthetic data only, tests first), so every follow-up change in Copilot Chat or agent mode works to the same rules.
